   945→        emode_group,

   961→
   962→    // triggering condition: 
   963→    // user_ltv > liquidation_ltv
   964→    if (liquidation_params.liquidation_ltv_threshold_override.is_some()) {
   965→        let liquidation_ltv = *liquidation_params.liquidation_ltv_threshold_override.borrow();

   968→            user_ltv.gt(liquidation_ltv),

   971→    } else {
   972→        // user_ltv = weighted_debts_value / collateral_total_value
   973→        // liquidation_ltv = collateral_weighted_value / collateral_total_value
   974→        // user_ltv > liquidation_ltv
